note: Marinette County campground near the Thunder River, a trout stream, with Veteran's Falls, a footbridge and hiking trails along the river below the campground. Twelve RV sites 35-52 ft long; sites 5-7 are short tent-only sites. Campers dump at Twin Bridge Park, 5 miles south. --Claude
summary: County page, 15 per-site pages, 2027 fee schedule, reservation policy and 2019 map read: 12 RV sites (1-4, 8-15) 35-52 ft, all 50-A at $45 (2027; stored $30-35 was the 30-A/tent-site rate) + $10 reservation fee; 5-7 tent only; 184-day window, 14-in-21 max; May 1 - Nov 30; hand pump, no dump. Not waterfront confirmed (loop ~150 m+ from the river through forest).
flags: FEES: stored $30-35 is the 30-amp rate, which on the map and site pages belongs only to tent-only sites 5-7 (15-20 ft). The page and the 2027 fee schedule charge $45 for 50 amp at sites 1-4 and 8-15, the only sites a 23-ft rig fits.

WATERFRONT: stored not waterfront confirmed. The 2019 park map puts the nearest site (8) ~150-170 m north of the Thunder River; Esri imagery shows the loop under continuous pine canopy away from the river.
PIN: stored 45.2714,-88.2086 is the park entrance on Parkway Rd; the loop centre is ~45.2703,-88.2075 (~150 m SE). Under 250 m, no move proposed.
SITES: stored 15 is correct but 3 of them (5-7) are tent-only; 12 RV sites.
